reorderHint: Reorder recipes: use the arrows to move a recipe in the list.
addHint: Add your own recipe or import recipes from formatted JSON (AI). Recipes are added to the plan and the shopping list is recalculated; manual lines stay.
clearHint: Removes every recipe from the plan. The shopping list is recalculated; lines added by hand stay.
clearBody: Every recipe will be removed from the plan. The shopping list will be updated; ingredients entered by hand stay on the list.
